content.short: Mojito is the all-in-one web3 platform powering brands and creators.
content.description: With Mojito, brands and creators can launch fully branded, customized web3 experiences—from initial mint drops to dedicated secondary marketplaces—enabling them to own their digital presence. The platform provides a complete toolkit for drop management, including minting, allowlists, redeemables, and support for both fiat and cryptocurrency payments to reach diverse audiences. Users can oversee upcoming mints, build and manage token communities, configure royalties, and access comprehensive collection analytics, all from the Mojito Mint Manager dashboard.
content.meta: Mojito helps brands and creators launch customized, fully branded web3 experiences. Discover Mojito and other Web3 Social Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
